Gamepad Tester has no account and never uploads your controller input or test results. The app does contain Google Firebase (analytics and configuration), Google Play Billing, and advertising SDKs from AppLovin and Google AdMob, which collect device-level data as described below.

Buying Gamepad Tester Pro removes ads, which stops the advertising SDKs from requesting or showing ads for you.

Summary of data collected

This table matches our Google Play Data safety declaration. Everything in it is sent over encrypted (HTTPS) connections.

Data typeCollected byShared with third partiesPurpose

Phone numberAdvertising SDKs (see §4)Yes — advertising partnersAdvertising, fraud prevention
Purchase history (whether a Pro purchase succeeded, was cancelled or failed)Google Play Billing, FirebaseNoApp functionality, analytics

We do not collect your name, email address (unless you email us), contacts, photos, files, precise location, installed-app list, or the input you generate on your controller.

What stays on your device

WhatDetails
Controller inputButton presses, stick and trigger positions, motion sensor and touchpad readings are processed in real time on your phone to draw the test screens. They are not recorded or uploaded.
Controller detailsName, vendor ID and product ID of connected controllers are read from Android to show device information and to match test history. They are not sent to analytics or ad partners.
Test historyResults of full tests are saved in a local database inside the app's private storage.
SettingsTheme, language, onboarding state, rating-prompt and ad-frequency counters.
Other appsThe app may check whether one specific app from the same developer is already installed, only to decide whether to show a promotion card. This check happens on the device and the result is not uploaded.

Analytics, configuration and purchases

Google Firebase

We use Firebase Analytics to understand which features are used, so we know what to improve. The app logs events such as opening a test, opening the FAQ, and purchase results, together with the data Firebase collects automatically (app instance ID, device model, Android version, app version, and approximate country or region derived from IP address). Firebase Remote Config lets us adjust settings such as promotions without an app update, and Firebase Cloud Messaging lets the app receive notifications. Google processes this data as our service provider under the Firebase privacy terms. Google Analytics event data is retained for no longer than 14 months.

Google Play Billing

Gamepad Tester Pro is a one-time purchase processed entirely by Google Play. We never see your payment card or billing details. The app receives purchase status and an order reference from Google Play to unlock Pro features, and logs whether a purchase attempt succeeded, was cancelled or failed.

Google Play In-App Review

The app may ask Google Play to show its rating card. Your rating and review go to Google Play, not to us, and the app is not told whether you submitted one.

Advertising

The free version shows ads served through AppLovin MAX, which mediates ads from AppLovin and Google AdMob. To serve, measure and protect ads against fraud, these SDKs collect and share with their own advertising partners: your Android advertising ID, device and network information, IP address and the approximate location derived from it, ad interactions, and crash and performance data. The SDKs may also use Android's Privacy Sandbox APIs (Topics, attribution) where available.

Gamepad Tester itself does not request any phone or contacts permission and never reads your phone number. Because advertising SDKs can change what they process through remote configuration, we declare “phone number” in our Data safety section as a precaution.

Our default privacy settings: in regions where consent for personalized ads is required (such as the EEA and UK), the app tells AppLovin that consent has not been given. For all users the app sets AppLovin's “do not sell” flag, as described in the California Consumer Privacy Act.

How to limit advertising data:

  • Reset or delete your advertising ID in Android Settings → Privacy → Ads (or Settings → Google → Ads).
  • Buy Gamepad Tester Pro to remove ads.

Privacy policies of our ad partners: AppLovin, Google Ads.

The app does not request location, camera, microphone, contacts, phone, SMS or storage permissions.

Information you choose to send

  • Feedback email. When you tap a “contact us” option, the app opens your email app with a pre-filled block: app version, device model, Android version, language, the selected controller's name and vendor/product ID, and your Pro purchase status with its Google Play order number. Nothing is sent until you press send in your email app, and you can edit or delete any of it first. We use it only to answer your message.
  • Sharing results. Exported test images and latency CSV files are handed to the app you pick in Android's share sheet. What that app does with them is governed by its own policy.

Backups

If Android backup is enabled on your device, the app's local settings and test history may be included in your personal Google account backup. That backup is controlled by you and Google; we have no access to it. You can turn it off in Settings → Google → Backup.

Retention and deletion

We do not run our own servers and do not keep a user database. Data held by Firebase is retained according to Google's retention controls (analytics event data for up to 14 months). Advertising partners retain data under their own policies.

To request deletion, email feedback@dapplebyte.com with the subject “Data deletion”. We will delete the analytics data we can link to your request and reply within 30 days. Because the app has no account, we may ask for details that help identify your installation. You can also:

  • uninstall the app, which removes all local data (settings, test history);
  • reset or delete your advertising ID so ad partners can no longer link new data to past data.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR in the EU/UK or the CCPA/CPRA in California), you may have the right to access, correct, delete or port your personal data, to object to or restrict processing, and to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data for targeted advertising. To exercise any of these rights, email us. We do not sell personal data for money; the app sets AppLovin's “do not sell” flag for all users, and you can further limit ad data as described in §4.

International transfers

Google, AppLovin and their partners may process data in the United States and other countries where they operate, under their own safeguards for international transfers.

Children

Gamepad Tester is a hardware testing tool and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided data through the app, contact us and we will delete what we can.

Security

All data collected by the included SDKs is transmitted over encrypted connections. Local data is kept in the app's private storage, which other apps cannot read. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

Changes to this policy

When this policy changes, the effective date at the top changes and the new version is published at the same address. Significant changes, such as adding a new kind of data collection, will also be mentioned in the app's release notes.

Contact

Questions or privacy requests: feedback@dapplebyte.com
